meta.title: Group name matches two entities whose routes diverge

payload.requisition_text:
Software Engineer — Client Solutions
Halcyon Group · London

Halcyon Group is a UK technology group serving the insurance sector: a product arm building claims-automation software and a consulting arm delivering integrations for carriers.

This role sits with the group's engineering function in London, building claims-triage workflows in Python and TypeScript for household-name insurers. Visa sponsorship can be arranged for the right candidate.

We're looking for 2+ years of software delivery experience; insurance knowledge is a bonus, not a requirement.

Package: £44,000, discretionary bonus, 26 days holiday. Offices at Fenchurch Street; hybrid by team agreement. Apply with CV to careers@ the group domain.

expected.determining_fact: Halcyon Group matches two registered entities whose licences diverge — Halcyon Technologies Ltd (Skilled Worker) and Halcyon Consulting (UK) Ltd (Global Business Mobility only) — and the posting does not establish which one employs this role.

evidence_anchors.willingness_quote: Visa sponsorship can be arranged for the right candidate

design_notes: The resolution genuinely decides the verdict: one candidate entity would make this sponsorable-shaped, the other kills it. Guessing either way is confident-wrong by construction. The uncertainty statement should tell the user exactly what to ask: which legal entity issues the contract.
